meta.purpose: The interpretive core — reading each characteristic-bearing span in its verse and recording what the verse does with it, as the ve_nr dimensions. This is the layer that FAILED: on 2026-07-14, 8 of 18 dimensions failed their own written rules and 0 passed. Everything in this file exists because a rule that lived in prose was ignored.
meta.the_governing_shift: Rules are no longer remembered — they are encoded here and enforced by the validation engine. The model produces only what genuinely requires inference ([I]), and every output it produces is checked by a [C] gate and retried on violation. An [I] value that fails its gate does not bank.
meta.envelope: Every item carries the common rule envelope — see ../_manifest.json meta.envelope. Its vocabularies are defined there and are NOT restated here.
meta.supersedes: config/dimensions.json (authored 2026-07-15) — absorbed into the `entities` node. Original archived at config/archive/dimensions-v1-20260715-absorbed-into-process-lexical.json.

open.issue: The genre x role mandatory ledger is contested — `recon.mandatory-ledger` (07-11 poetic base vs 07-14 M16 making 109/110/111/117/118 mandatory; 103/111 per-span vs Phase-2-only).
open.consequence: `lexical.ledger` is status RECONCILE, so THE LOADER WILL NOT RUN THIS PROCESS. The ledger defines what a read must produce; without it, 'complete' is undefined.
open.resolve_by: researcher ruling on recon.mandatory-ledger — the single hardest blocker on this process

open.issue: `gate.lexical.self-interpretable` is declared [C] red, but 'is this value readable without the verse' is not obviously mechanically decidable. A length floor and a truncation check catch the 07-14 artefacts (malformed, truncated-mid-word values) but would pass a well-formed, uninterpretable value.
open.consequence: The gate would give false assurance on exactly the rule it exists to enforce — the pattern the failure record names as 'completeness checked, not validity'.
options: A: [C] structural floor only (not-truncated, min length, contains its trigger) + accept it is partial
B: [C] floor + [I] sampled judge on a sample per run
C: [I] per value (expensive; and the model self-certifying its own output is the failure mode this design exists to prevent)
open.recommendation: B — the [C] floor runs over everything and catches the known artefact class; the [I] judge samples and cannot self-certify because it judges a DIFFERENT model call's output. C is disallowed by the design's own logic.

open.issue: `gate.lexical.sense-matches-subgloss` is the gate for the dimension that failed hardest (D101 recorded interpretation, not the sub-gloss). But matching a produced sense against a lexicon sub-gloss is fuzzy, not exact — the sub-gloss is a gloss list, and the read must pick the per-occurrence one.
options: A: exact membership — sense MUST be one of the sub-glosses verbatim (mechanical, red; may be too rigid for real text)
C: [I] judge: 'is this sense one of these sub-glosses?'
open.recommendation: A first, and see what it rejects. The 07-14 failure was not a near-miss — 'public good' for tsaddiq is not a sub-gloss at all, and a strict gate would have caught it on the first row. Loosen only against evidence.

open.issue: D109 shape `pair/flag` and D117 shape `value/pair` are not members of enum.pair_kind, so `gate.lexical.shape-matches-pair-kind` cannot run for them. Both FAILED on 07-14.
open.recommendation: Model the head and the pair as two rows (head value + optional pair row), so every stored row has one simple pair_kind and the gate is total. Carried from dimensions.json meta.open.compound-shapes.

open.issue: Five dimensions (109/111/117/118 + 110) were RETROFITTED BY REGEX and all failed. `lexical.no-mechanical-extraction` states the prohibition, but a [C] gate cannot see HOW a value was produced — only what it looks like.
open.consequence: The single most damaging technique in the failure record is prohibited by a rule that cannot be enforced on the value itself.
options: A: provenance-based — every ve_lexical row records the method that produced it; the gate refuses `method=regex` for [I]/[I-partial] dimensions
B: artefact-based only — the truncation/malformation gates catch regex output indirectly
C: process-based — the API adapter is the only writer for interpretive dims; regex has no write path
open.recommendation: A + C. C makes it structurally impossible; A makes it detectable if someone routes around C. B alone is what we had.

process.authority: ve-lexical catalogue v1 §2 (D1); researcher 2026-07-14 (D1 acceptance failure)
process.intent: Bind D101 sense to an external authority, so the read cannot substitute its own interpretation for the word's meaning. This is the spine: sense is resolved first and everything else hangs off it.
process.satisfaction: Every D101 value is the STEP sub-gloss for THIS occurrence — not the verse's proposition, not the effect, not a paraphrase.

spec.statement: sense = the per-occurrence STEP sub-gloss. Authority = ent.raw.lexicon (gloss + sub-glosses).
spec.failure_it_prevents: 2026-07-14: D1 FAILED acceptance — reads recorded interpretation/effect instead of the sub-gloss (tsaddiq -> 'public good'). Per the researcher's rule, D1 must be redone in total.

process.intent: Fix the unit of the read as the occurrence, not the word — because the same lemma means different things in different verses, and reading at lemma grain relabels a fixed constant as a per-verse discovery.
process.satisfaction: One lexical read per SPAN (term-in-verse). No value is carried across occurrences of the same lemma.

spec.statement: A term is a SPAN/SENSE, not a lemma. The grain is per-occurrence sub-gloss.
spec.failure_it_prevents: The grid relabelled fixed lemma-constants (faculty, type) as per-verse discoveries — a named root cause (plan §1.2, 'ungrounded frames read as findings').

process.intent: Hold the read to what the verse actually says, which is the difference between inference and eisegesis. Cold-read validation found ~70-85% of analytical claims imported meaning the verses do not carry.
process.satisfaction: Every value traces to something IN the verse (or its passage where the ledger permits cross-verse). A value with no basis in the text is an ERROR, not a weak reading.

spec.statement: The lexical records ONLY what the verse says. No implied evidence. A no-basis value is an error.
spec.note: Plausibility is not truth — a plausible value with no textual basis is the exact failure mode of the two prior studies, whose findings 'appeared strong at first but deteriorated under further questioning'.

process.authority: researcher 2026-07-14 (acceptance audit); plan §1.2 'extraction mistaken for inference'
process.intent: Prohibit the technique that produced the worst of the 07-14 failures — regex/keyword sweeps logging values the verse never stated, dressed as analysis.
process.satisfaction: No interpretive dimension value is produced by pattern-matching. Inference is inference; the API adapter is its only writer.

spec.statement: Infer, don't extract. Regex/keyword derivation of an interpretive value is prohibited.
spec.failure_it_prevents: D109 intensity, D111 effect, D117 device, D118 direction + D110 specifier were REGEX-RETROFITTED and all failed — malformed and truncated-mid-word values, wrong classifications.
spec.open: open.lexical.regex-prohibition — a [C] gate cannot see how a value was produced, only what it looks like.

process.intent: Make every value readable on its own, so the corpus can be audited without re-reading every verse — and so a thin value cannot masquerade as a finding.
process.satisfaction: Every value carries its trigger and its sense, readable without re-opening the verse. Bare codes and thin values are forbidden.

spec.statement: A dimension value must be readable without re-reading the verse.
spec.was: dimensions.json governing_value_rules -> dimrule.self-interpretable — PROSE, unenforceable, inside a rulebook
spec.now: a rule here + gate.lexical.self-interpretable in validation

process.intent: Distinguish 'looked for and found nothing' from 'never looked' — without which silence is unreadable and coverage is a lie.
process.satisfaction: 109/110/111/117/118 are assessed from the qualifier spans and record `none` EXPLICITLY. ABSENT (never assessed) is forbidden.

spec.statement: Assessed-and-none is a finding. Never-assessed is a defect. Write `none`, never omit.
spec.connects: silence is a valid finding (plan §1.1) — but only when it is RECORDED silence.

process.intent: Keep the two kinds of emptiness apart: the verse says nothing (none) versus the read could not determine it (unknown). Conflating them destroys the meaning of both.

spec.statement: silence (`none`) and unresolved (`unknown`) are DISTINCT and must never be conflated.
spec.moved_from: enums.json enum.resolution spec.rule — an application rule sitting in a definitional item (2026-07-15 ruling §3)
spec.note: ⚠ RECONCILE — the vocabulary has 3 variants across sources (catalogue / 01b / collection). Blocks this process.

process.intent: Make the unmarked case explicit, so 'literal' is a recorded read rather than an empty field.
process.satisfaction: D117 device is `literal` unless the read finds a device.

spec.statement: device defaults to `literal`. A default is NOT `none`: default = the unmarked normal case; `none` = assessed and genuinely absent.
spec.moved_from: enums.json enum.device spec.default — application, not definition (2026-07-15 ruling §3)

process.authority: ve-lexical catalogue v1 §2 (D3); researcher 2026-07-14 (D3 acceptance failure)
process.intent: Hold D103's direction, because a reversed pair records the opposite of what the verse says — and this is the error that failed D3.
process.satisfaction: D103 runs driver -> term, and DRIVER is distinguished from RESTRAINT.

spec.statement: source = what drives the characteristic (driver -> term), never what the characteristic acts on (that is D107 target, term -> object). DRIVER and RESTRAINT must be split.
spec.failure_it_prevents: 2026-07-14: D3 FAILED — it stored target-direction pairs (term -> object).

process.intent: Keep the study's object in view: the HUMAN inner being. God is the arena in which it moves, never its bearer.
process.satisfaction: D105 bearer is always human. A God-bearer is a Screen-0 failure, not a characteristic.

spec.statement: bearer != God. God's own attribute or action is a qualifier or the arena; a pure God-verse yields no characteristic.
spec.failure_it_prevents: 2026-07-14: Screen-0 mis-roles seen in D115 — Pro 8:28 'God made firm the skies' was roled `characteristic`.
spec.owner: the rule is shared with the characteristics process (Screen 0); defined ONCE, here, and cited there (layout v2 §2.3).

process.intent: Define what a COMPLETE read is — which dimensions are required for a given genre and role. This is the definition of 'done' for the lexical layer.
process.satisfaction: Every read produces every dimension its (genre, role) ledger requires, with `none` written where assessed-and-absent.

spec.per_role: characteristic = full · qualifier = reduced · standalone = minimal — ⚠ not yet specified
spec.note: ⚠ RECONCILE — BLOCKS THIS ENTIRE PROCESS (open.lexical.ledger-blocked). 07-14 made 109/110/111/117/118 mandatory, contradicting the 07-11 poetic base. Ruled home = `process`, not `validation` (layout v2 §5): the ledger defines what the read must PRODUCE; gate.lexical.ledger-complete then checks it did.

process.intent: Vary the read treatment by genre, because poetry and narrative carry the inner being differently — cross-verse movement is native to narrative and misleading in a poem read verse-by-verse.
process.satisfaction: The read treatment matches ent.raw.verse's genre via this route.

spec.absorbs: dimensions.json spec.genre_note on D103/D111 — applicability is the ledger's and this route's job, not a dimension's (dimensions.json meta.open.genre-note-home)

entities.intent: The lexical read itself — one row per dimension-value on a span. The interpretation layer's atom.
entities.satisfaction: One row per (span, ve_nr, value), carrying its shape, resolution and provenance.

entities._comment: ── The ve_nr dimensions (101-118). DEFINITIONAL ONLY per the 2026-07-15 ruling: no validation blocks, no rules, no defaults. Envelope defaults below apply to every dimension item.

entities.intent: the per-occurrence sense of the word = the STEP sub-gloss; the spine, resolved first
the POS-derived type of the characteristic
the driver/antecedent of the characteristic
the constitutional seat (heart/soul/spirit) of the characteristic, via construct chain
the experiencer/subject who bears the characteristic
the governing predicate — the act the characteristic performs
the object the characteristic acts on, with its object-type
the prep-marked adverbial qualifier of the characteristic
degree/amount from the modifying qualifier (me'od / kol / doubled / emphatic)
the narrowing qualifier (which one) — construct genitive / 'of the LORD' / 'this'
the produced-state from the result/consequence qualifier
the morphological weld only — construct/preposition binding to a co-term
a mechanical negation/prohibition particle on the term
the evidence-anchored reading note (translit + capitalised verse-quote + meaning + surfaced finding); the uncertainty channel
the sanity-check classification of the span (set BY the read, not derived)
classify the target/bearer entity as IB-internal vs external
the literary device the characteristic is expressed through; the comparison-device pair endpoint is the VEHICLE span
the movement vector of the characteristic
Record the dropped dimensions so legacy data stays interpretable and no read reintroduces them.

spec.rule: not to be written. Present in legacy data only.

output.intent: A readable projection of the lexical layer for researcher review — the DB is authoritative, this is regenerable.
output.satisfaction: Projection regenerable from the DB at any time; nothing authoritative lives only here.

output.intent: The per-dimension acceptance verdict — the artefact that told the truth on 07-14 when everything else said 'complete'.
output.satisfaction: Every dimension carries a current verdict against the acceptance rule.

spec.baseline: the 2026-07-14 verdicts (8 FAILED / 10 in-progress / 0 passed) are the baseline this build must beat
spec.note: This is the process's real definition of done — not coverage.

validation._comment: ── Gates. Per the 2026-07-15 definitional ruling, every check that was a dimension's `validation` block now lives here as a gate. Each cites the dimension(s) it guards.

validation.intent: Refuse any enum-bound dimension value outside its vocabulary — the cheapest, most total check in the system.
validation.satisfaction: Every enum-bound value is a member of its enum's spec.values.

spec.enforcement_note: PROJECTED AS CHECK CONSTRAINTS by the config-maintenance utility, generated from each enum's spec.values. The vocabulary is defined ONCE in wide/enums.json; the constraint is its projection (2026-07-15 ruling §1.1).
spec.blocked: role · locus are RECONCILE — their constraints cannot be generated until recon.role-enum and recon.locus-vocab are ruled.

validation.intent: Catch a reversed pair, which records the opposite of what the verse says. Direction is load-bearing, not cosmetic.
validation.satisfaction: Every pair's from/to endpoints match its dimension's declared pair_from / pair_to.

spec.failure_it_catches: 2026-07-14: D3 source stored target-direction pairs (term -> object instead of driver -> term). This gate would have red-halted it on the first row.

validation.intent: Enforce the difference between recorded silence and unexamined silence — the distinction that makes 'silence is a valid finding' meaningful.
validation.satisfaction: Every mandatory dimension has a value or an explicit `none`. No mandatory dimension is ABSENT.

spec.note: Cannot be db:not-null — 'mandatory' is per (genre, role) via lexical.ledger, not per column. A conditional rule is exactly what enforcement `gate` is for.

validation.intent: Refuse a value that cannot be read without the verse — and catch the malformed/truncated artefacts the regex retrofit produced.
validation.satisfaction: Every value is well-formed, not truncated, and carries its trigger + sense.

spec.note: ⚠ RECONCILE — a [C] structural floor catches the 07-14 artefact class but would pass a well-formed yet uninterpretable value. See open.lexical.self-interpretable-check.

validation.intent: Guard the spine. D101 failed acceptance by recording interpretation instead of the sub-gloss; this is the gate that makes that impossible.
validation.satisfaction: Every D101 value is a sub-gloss of the span's Strong's entry in ent.raw.lexicon.

spec.note: ⚠ RECONCILE — exact vs normalised vs [I]-judged membership undecided. Note the 07-14 failure was not a near-miss: 'public good' for tsaddiq is not a sub-gloss at all, so even the strictest form would have caught it.

validation.intent: Keep the stored row's shape honest against its dimension's declared shape.
validation.satisfaction: Every row's pair_kind matches its dimension's spec.shape.

spec.gap: ⚠ CANNOT RUN for dim.109 (`pair/flag`) or dim.117 (`value/pair`) — compound shapes are not members of enum.pair_kind. Both FAILED on 07-14. A silent hole in a red gate: see open.lexical.compound-shapes.

validation.intent: Decide 'done' for a read — every dimension the (genre, role) ledger requires is present.
validation.satisfaction: The span's dimension set covers its ledger, with `none` where assessed-and-absent.

spec.note: ⚠ RECONCILE — blocked with the ledger. This is where 'done = validity, not coverage' is enforced (plan §3.2).

validation.intent: Catch imported meaning — the ~70-85% eisegesis rate cold-read validation found. The gravest risk in the study, and the one only a challenge surfaces.
validation.satisfaction: Every value traces to text in the verse (or its passage where the ledger permits).

spec.note: ⚠ The only [I]-axis gate here. It judges a DIFFERENT model call's output — the model never certifies its own read. Ties to open.lexical.self-interpretable-check option B.

validation.intent: The per-dimension verdict that decides whether the layer may be trusted at all — the test that exposed the 07-14 failure.
validation.satisfaction: Every dimension passes the acceptance rule.
